simple.meaning: חֵפֶץ (chêphets) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “pleasure ; hence (abstractly) desire ; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 39 times across 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Job, and 7 more, beginning at 1 Samuel 15:22. Its contexts include offering, sacrifice, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֵפֶץ (H2656).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֵפֶץ (chêphets) / H2656 is traced through 1 Samuel 15:22, 1 Samuel 18:25, 2 Samuel 23:5, 1 Kings 5:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: pleasure ; hence (abstractly) desire ; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
definitions.usage: acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.
definitions.full: H2656. chephets חֵ֫פֶץ noun masculine Prov 3:15 delight, pleasure ; — ׳ח Isa 54:12 20t.; suffix חֶפְצְךָ 58:13 etc. + 13 t. suffixes; plural חֲפָצִים Prov 8:11 ; suffix חֲפָצֶיךָ 3:15 ; חֲפָצֶ֖ךָ Isa 58:13 — 1 delight ח ׳אבני Isa 54:12 delightful stones ; ח ׳אֶרֶץ Mal 3:12 delightsome land ; ח ׳דִּבְּרֵי Eccl 12:10 ; so perhaps also ח ׳בִּגְדֵי Ezek 27:20 garments of delight , i.e. of beauty and luxury (Gr; חֹפֶשׁ ᵑ0 q. v.); with בְּ of persons Psa 16:3 ; Eccl 5:3 ; Mal 1:10 ; of things 1Sam 15:22 ; 18:25 ; Psa 1:2 ; Job 21:21 ; Eccl 12:1 ; בּוֺ חֵפֶץ אֵין כְּלִי vessel wherein is no pleasure Jer 22:28 ; 48:38 ; Hosea 8:8 ; כִּי לְשַׁדַּי הַחֵפֶץ Job 22:3 is it a pleasure to Shadday that ? 2 desire, longing מח ׳מנע דלים Job 31:16 withhold the poor from ( their ) desire ; חֶפְצָם מְחוֺז the city of their desire Psa 107:30 ; חפץ כל all ( one's ) desire 2Sam 23:5 ; 1 Kings 5:22; 1 Kings 5:23; 1 Kings 5:24; 1Kin 9:11 ; 10:13 2Chr 9:12 ; חפצים כל all things to be desired Prov 3:15 ; 8:11 . 3 the good pleasure, will, purpose , of Yahweh Isa 44:28 ; 46:10 ; 48:14 . 4 that in which one takes delight, his business (late), or matter (very late, compare in Mishna = thing ) י ׳חֵפֶץ יִצְלַח בְּיָדוֺ the good pleasure ( cause, business ) of Yahweh will prosper in his hands Isa 53:10 ; ח ׳מצא 58:3 , 13 ; חֲפָצֶךָ עֲשׂוֺת doing thy affairs 58:13 (see De on the passage); כַּמֶּיהָ בְּחֵפֶץ in the business of her hands Prov 31:13 ; לְכָלחֵֿפֶץ עֵתּ time for every matter, affair Eccl 3:1 , 17 ; 8:6 ; עַלהַֿחֵפֶץ תִּתְּמַהּ אַלֿ marvel not at the matter 5:7 . Note. — חפץ is not used in any of its forms in E D 2 H P of the Hexateuch.
